scope: Tesla Charge Companion V9 German CPO first-pass

this_pass.evidence: Official 2026 public-charging page explicitly publishes credit-card/ad-hoc pricing valid from 01.04.2026 on Stadtwerke Münster stations: AC EUR 0.47/kWh plus EUR 0.05/min after 240 minutes; DC EUR 0.52/kWh plus EUR 0.05/min after 60 minutes. At car parks and Park & Ride locations, the AC time component starts only after 480 minutes. Time charges are waived between 22:00 and 06:00 while elapsed time continues to count. QR/card checkout is documented.

this_pass.canonical_name: SWB Energie und Wasser / Stadtwerke Bonn
this_pass.evidence: Official current public-charging page explicitly applies the published prices to both SWB eCharge and smartphone direct payment: AC and DC up to 50 kW EUR 0.49/kWh plus EUR 0.10/min from minute 241 between 08:00 and 22:00; DC above 50 kW EUR 0.56/kWh plus EUR 0.10/min from minute 61. Ad-hoc QR/short-link payment supports Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal without prior registration.

Official current FAQ confirms ad-hoc QR charging with PayPal or credit card and documents the Stadtwerkedrive contract tariff at EUR 0.50/kWh AC/DC (night AC EUR 0.40/kWh) with blocking fees. The operator explicitly warns that ad-hoc prices can differ from its own card tariff, so the card tariff was not promoted to direct payment.
this_pass.reason: ad-hoc access proven, but exact current ad-hoc checkout price not published on official web surface

this_pass.evidence: Official current station page lists the Solingen charging estate and states that current AC/DC per-kWh prices are displayed only in the Stadtwerke Solingen Lade-App. Registered customers have the EUR 0.49 session start fee waived and there is no basic monthly fee. No numeric current station tariff is published on the web page.
this_pass.reason: numeric current AC/DC price is app-only

this_pass.evidence: Official August 2026 material confirms EWR, SR and PSR operate the public AC network in Remscheid and introduces a customer-only 'Laden wie Zuhause' tariff using ChargePoint, currently illustrated at EUR 0.32/kWh for EWR*STROM Natur plus customers. This is explicitly conditional on the household electricity contract and ChargePoint account; no universal ad-hoc tariff was established.
this_pass.reason: verified customer-specific price exists, but no universal direct/ad-hoc price proven

this_pass.canonical_name: STAWAG – Stadt- und Städteregionswerke Aachen AG
this_pass.evidence: Official current material confirms STAWAG operates more than 700 publicly usable charging points in the Aachen region and offers STAWAG/Basis contract tariffs via its charging card and app. The current web surface does not expose a numeric universal direct-payment/ad-hoc tariff; prices depend on tariff, charge type and operator.
this_pass.reason: operator/network confirmed; no numeric universal current direct-payment tariff exposed in first pass

coherence.policy: First-pass coverage prioritized; four unresolved operators were deferred immediately after reasonable official-source investigation.
coherence.duplicate_check: The six canonical identities were not present in checkpoints automation33-37; aliases are not counted separately. No previously deferred CPO was re-audited.
